newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Island Dyeing share trading suspended.
newsitem.headline: Island Dyeing share trading suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Island Dyeing and Printing Co Ltd was suspended in late morning at the company's request pending an announcement, the stock exchange said on Wednesday.
Island Dyeing shares were last traded at HK$7.70 per share, up 20 cents. Volume was 26,000 shares.

The company said on Monday that its main shareholders Itochu Corp, Itochu Hong Kong Ltd and Daido-Maruta Finishing Co Ltd were in preliminary discussions for the sale of a total 45 percent of the company to an independent third party.

Island Dyeing's director Yoshinori Izeki had said it was anticipated that the 29.70 million shares would be sold at a price of less than HK$8.45 per share but no binding agreement had yet been entered.
Island Dyeing, which ceased its dyeing and printing operation in 1995, is engaged in property development and investment.
